item.title: FlatBot/ImmoScout24 automation: Captcha handling, ban risk, and persistent sessions—worth it for a non-coder?
item.description:
Hi all
I’m not a developer, but with ChatGPT’s help (and lots of screenshot troubleshooting), I managed to set up [FlatBot](https://github.com/kine90/FlatBot) on my Mac to automate ImmoScout24 flat applications. For context, it's very hard to find flats where I live, so these sorts of resources limit the amount of time on this process, which often requires full time focus for 3-6 months or so depending on pickiness. I’m using a dedicated Gmail, ImmoScout24 account, and Chrome profile. My search volume is low (2–8 new listings per day) because I’m targeting specific areas/prices.
**The main issues:**
* FlatBot always gets stuck on the “Ich bin kein Roboter” captcha. I’ve set up 2Captcha (balance is used, “solved” shows in logs), but the bot never gets past the captcha screen. * ImmoScout24 also seems to also sometimes require email verification codes, which I enter manually. * I’m worried about account bans (and losing my 12-month premium) if I keep automating, even at low volume. * I’ve read about using persistent Chrome profiles to “remember” sessions, but am unsure if this helps or increases risk.
**Questions for technical people:**
* Is there any realistic way to solve ImmoScout24’s current captchas automatically (with 2Captcha, AntiCaptcha, or other services)? * Are there code-level changes that could help, or is this a limitation of the site’s captcha system? * Is it safer to use a fresh profile every session or a persistent one (with user-data-dir)? * Are there real-world ban reports for low-volume, “human-like” automation with dedicated accounts? * Is it worth pushing on with this, or should I go back to manual applications (even if I miss out on flats due to timing)? Bear in mind, I am actually quite enjoying getting to understand this sort of process and want to learn automation techniques in the future and have a professional/personal interest in it.
**Background:**
* All setup and troubleshooting done via ChatGPT, no coding background. * Mac user, dedicated email/accounts/profiles for all bot activity. * Willing to try technical solutions with clear instructions!
Any advice or real-world experience would be much appreciated!
